name: ModelVariant806_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant806_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a charge sprite brightens on a model part while two glowing trails stream from two parts, then a core of spinning rings opens on the part behind a white flash and sparks burst out of the opposing slot, each throwing off tumbling embers, while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the sparks and embers and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 while charging, 4 from the burst time until the flash, 1 once when the flash starts, 2 once the sparks and flash have faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-823 and 920 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
